programme.title: I was the king – Marcin Robak | S01E06
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Marcin Robak is a two-time top scorer in the Ekstraklasa. He is the last Pole to win this title so far. In total, he scored 120 goals in the top league. Marcin Robak scored 22 goals for Pogoń Szczecin in the 2013/2014 season. He finished the 2016/2017 season in Lech Poznań with 18 goals. He then had to share the crown with Marco Paixao. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Hero from the Shadow – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza | E02
programme.desc: The series presents the profiles of people working behind the scenes of Polish football clubs. They perform very important duties necessary for the functioning of the team, which are often invisible to outsiders. Krzysztof Kozik has been the manager of the first team of Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza for 20 years. He has been a resident of Nieciecza since birth. In the 1980s, he reactivated the LZS Nieciecza football club, which is an Ekstraklasa newcomer in the 2025/26 season. Kozik, known as Kiero, was also an active player and scored 245 goals for the team in the lower leagues. Poland. documentary series

programme.title: Morata: they don't know who I am
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.1» The old guard receives the recording of a new season of the series with many cautions. However, the new generation sees it as an opportunity. They are very different personalities, two very different worlds that share a team. Enric Mas, the veteran leader of the men's team, opens up more to the rest of his teammates. It is a renewed Enric, closer. He is preparing for the Tour with more ambition than ever. Iván Romeo is the visible head of a group of young runners who want to change things. He is ambitious, close, natural and with the soul of a leader. We know his most intimate side. He comes from a family passionate about cycling. As a child I traveled to France to watch the Tour go by from the sidelines. Now he is preparing for his first appearance in the race. His consecration comes in Dauphiné. With his stage victory, all the emotions come out. It has taken a while to get to where it is, but it is now a reality. In the Tour the first problems arrive for Enric

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 1
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.2» In the Tour, Enric does not go. What few know is that he suffers a major injury that weakens him more every day. In the middle of the chaos, Ivan Romeo appears. He dreams of his first stage in the Tour. On the women's team, Reusser has arrived to be the leader, but she has had problems for a long time. His crown in the Giro seems close, but the ghosts of the past return. She cries inconsolably after a great effort without reward. It is an example of improvement, but you will have to continue fighting. In addition, another figure stands out in the team, Liane Lippert. After the Tour, the men's team prepares for the race on which they have all their hopes: the Vuelta. However, Enric fails to recover in time. It's a suit for everyone. Iran without a leader. However, it is the perfect time to see the younger ones. That's when an unexpected figure appears. Aular flies and surprises directors and colleagues

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 2
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.3» The challenge is huge. The idea is to hunt stages. Enric supports the team from a distance, while the new generation in charge of leading the race fights with hunger. Reusser has overcome her problems and becomes CRI world and European champion. Face a new season with all its ghosts chased away. Meanwhile, in the men's Vuelta victory is very close, but something always fails at the last minute. It is an atypical and complicated return, but the team does not lose focus. Romo cherishes glory, but has to end up abandoning due to a fall. Communication problems appear between directors and brokers. To solve them, the figure of the psychologist is key. The year ends and the results are not as expected. A question appears in the air: when will the Movistar Team win again? The answer is optimism. The new generation is here to stay. to win

programme.title: 30 for 30: Doc & Darryl
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Seconds before disaster (Fukushima)
programme.desc: In March 2011, Japan suffered the most powerful earthquake in its history. A 14-meter tsunami hits the Fukushima nuclear power plant, knocking out its external power supply and cooling systems, causing the core reactors to melt. Due to overheating, two huge explosions occurred, which destroyed the station and led to the spread of radiation. That day, Japan faced its worst accident since Chernobyl. An international nuclear expert will thoroughly analyze this case and tell us whether this tragedy could have been prevented. United Kingdom

Evolution Earth (S1E1). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep1 «Evolution Earth»…Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planetEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Oliver TwinchCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

While Nathalie and her team rush to secure funding for a new facility, the medical team is baffled by a toad who has mysteriously taken illThis 12 part documentary series will show which animals actually live in the city, and what kind of trouble they encounter. When they do need help a rescue team is dispatched. Once rescued the animals are brought to this humble, but efficient, facility where a full time veterinarian is on hand. Problems are assessed, plans are put into action. programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Absent Friends (S3E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2023. S3, Ep5
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S3, Ep5 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedomCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problemsEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Oliver TwinchCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. programme.desc: (Trực tiếp) Tiêu điểm về Đông Á, một khu vực có bề dày lịch sử và hiện đang giúp viết nên tương lai của thế giới chúng ta. Chúng tôi sẽ chia nhỏ những câu chuyện chính và giải thích lý do tại sao chúng quan trọng.

programme.title: BÍ QUYẾT TÀI TÌNH TRONG CUỘC SỐNG HIỆN ĐẠI - THE SECRET GENIUS OF MODERN LIFE
programme.desc: Hannah xem xét nồi chiên không khí - một thiết bị đang nhanh chóng chiếm lĩnh căn bếp của mọi người, nấu mọi thứ từ bánh mì cuộn đến món Alaska nướng và gần như khiến lò nướng trở nên lỗi thời.

programme.title: CÂU CÁ MẠO HIỂM CÙNG ROBSON GREEN - EXTREME FISHING WITH ROBSON GREEN
programme.desc: Cuộc hành trình của Robson bắt đầu trên Đảo Ascension, một tiền đồn nhỏ với vùng nước chưa được đánh bắt ở giữa Đại Tây Dương.

programme.title: QUẢNG ĐÔNG HOANG DÃ CỦA TRUNG QUỐC - CHINA'S WILD GUANGDONG
programme.desc: Ở phía bắc Quảng Đông, những dãy núi hùng vĩ là nơi sinh sống của nhiều loài động vật hoang dã rực rỡ; Gà lôi bạc, tê tê Trung Quốc, diều đen, kỳ nhông khổng lồ Trung Quốc và một loài tắc kè hang động mới.

programme.title: PADDY VÀ CHRIS: DU LỊCH ĐƯỜNG DÀI - PADDY AND CHRIS: ROAD TRIPPING
